title: pnpm store mismatch triggered runaway dependency recreation
cause_event_consequence: The evidence wrapper invoked pnpm without the dedicated store configuration so verifyDepsBeforeRun attempted an automatic install before lint or tests
trigger_or_evidence: evidence/87-local-checkpoint-pnpm-store-failure/validate.log plus gvs-mismatch.log and targeted process metrics
response_or_decision: Stopped only the exact child after 20 minutes and 5.6 GiB private memory; isolated the incomplete node_modules; restored 478 packages from the dedicated local store; made evidence capture verify the active store and required binaries while disabling all automatic dependency mutation
contingency: Retain the diagnostic logs; never claim this was a test failure; repeat the full gate on a clean commit

title: Dependency advisory endpoint blocked inside sandbox

response_or_decision: Classify the sandbox audit call as NOT_TESTED; preserve its log; repeat the same audit with approved network access without changing lockfile or dependencies
contingency: Do not convert a network failure into either a vulnerability finding or a clean SCA result
